text:
maria: APAC gpu-pool-2 just dropped ~35% available GPUs, jobs piling. I want to soft-evacuate non-dedicated traffic to EU while we triage. Proposing GLB steer and a small canary.
raj: Ack. Do we have a current routing policy snapshot? Any customers pinned to APAC that we must preserve?
maria: Current: policy=latency_preferred, weights: apac=70, eu=20, na=10, ttl=60s. Dedicated and enterprise tenants are pinned via customer_affinity; only hosted/default plans affected. Proposing canary=5% -> ramp to 50% over 10m, target weights apac=20 eu=70 na=10.
sam: Heads up — KV cache affinity will suffer, expect cold-cache latency. Suggest swapping routed model in EU to quantized fallback for shifted traffic to keep latency within SLA and reduce memory pressure. Also consider increasing max_batch_tokens to help throughput.
maria: Good call. Plan: set fallback-model=model-quant-v2 for steer-tagged traffic, set max_batch_tokens=128 temporarily, and add route header X-RW-STEER=apac-failover for traceability.
jo: Cost check — EU GPU pricing is higher right now. Are we ok with short-term cost increase? I'll notify accounts if customer-visible impact is likely.
raj: Cost delta estimate +~18% for shifted token spend based on current mix. We have burst credits but will attach a budget guard to the incident run.
devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-APAC-GPU-DEGRADE. Runbook: /runbooks/gslb-evac. Pager duty pages sent.
maria: Executing canary in 2m unless objections. Commands I'll run:
```
routectl set-weight region=apac weight=20
routectl set-weight region=eu weight=70
routectl set-weight region=na weight=10
routectl set-canary percent=5 duration=300
```
raj: Lower health-check flapping sensitivity for 5m (threshold 2/3) to avoid oscillation. Also enable route-level circuit-breaker: consecutive_errors=50.
sam: Also add a temporary KV-miss monitor and a sampling probe to measure cache-warmup latency on shifted prefixes.
maria: Will enable both. Adding tracing tag and a short-lived dashboard. Rolling out canary now.
[~5m later]
maria: Canary stable: p95 latency on shifted requests +40ms, error rate unchanged. KV miss rate +12% but warming. Proceeding to ramp to 50% over 10m.
sam: Observed batching throughput improved slightly after bump; CPU stays healthy. Keep an eye on model memory for quantized fallback.
raj: Budget guard in place, alert at +25% spend and at 1hr. Notify if we cross.
jo: I'm prepping comms for affected self-serve customers and flagging enterprise slack for any pinned tenants.
maria: Ramp complete — updated weights apac=20 eu=70 na=10, canary disabled. Routing header X-RW-STEER present on shifted traffic. Marking incident as mitigation-in-progress; will keep monitoring and revert when pool heals.
devops-bot: Note: related ticket GPU-4521 opened for pool investigation. ETA for full restore unknown.
maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups: postmortem + check if eviction/oom patterns caused the node loss, validate autoscaler policies, and consider pre-warm strategy for future rapid steers.
raj: Adding action item to optimize steer cost model and add cheaper fallback capacity in APAC.
sam: I'll add a playbook snippet about model fallback + KV migration notes.
jo: I'll sync with customer success tomorrow on usage impact.
maria: Closing live steering actions. Monitoring continues; will update thread with heal timeline.
